docs.summary: Holds one live [`SpriteEditTarget`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.SpriteEditTarget) per texture so the texture inspector and the Sprite Editor window edit the same [`SpriteImportSettings`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.SpriteImportSettings) instance. The Sprite Editor just mutates it and flags it dirty; the inspector owns the actual "Save & Reimport" (persist to `.meta` + reimport).
Gets the shared target for a texture, loading its settings from the `.meta` on first use.

docs.summary: Replaces a texture's sprite settings wholesale - used when a revert restores the meta values and the live copy has to follow.
Returns true if the texture's sprite settings have been modified and not yet re-serialized.
Clears the dirty flag for the given texture, acknowledging that the settings have been re-serialized.
Reloads the target's settings from disk, discarding unsaved edits.
